free_tier.stated: Free: USD 0, 100 credits a month, a limited-time daily active reward of 30 credits a day, 250 welcome credits on sign-up, 5,000 code completions a month (unlimited during the promotion), auto model routing (all models during the promotion), 3 automated tasks
free_tier.notes: the credit cost of a request is not published; credits vary by model tier, task complexity and context length, so request-count is the nearest metered_on term. Pro is USD 10 a month or USD 96 a year (USD 8 a month) with 1,000 base and 1,000 bonus credits a month and a limited-time 50 credits a day; the pricing page offers the first month at USD 7. Base and bonus credits are valid for the current month and do not carry over.

interface_detail: CodeBuddy IDE on Windows and macOS and CodeBuddy Code CLI (`codebuddy` or `cbc`). The CLI runs headless with `-p`/`--print`, prints text, json or stream-json, and needs `-y` for operations that require authorization; a lighter headless build supports `--print`, `--serve` and `--acp`. An individual authenticates with CODEBUDDY_API_KEY from codebuddy.ai/profile/keys
tooling: CodeBuddy IDE and the CodeBuddy Code CLI; a China edition runs the same CLI with CODEBUDDY_INTERNET_ENVIRONMENT=internal
chaining: CODEBUDDY_API_KEY with CODEBUDDY_BASE_URL points the CLI at a third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as OpenRouter, so the agent outlives the monthly credits on another provider's key

limits.value: Free: 100 credits a month plus a limited-time 30 credits a day; Pro: 1,000 base and 1,000 bonus credits a month plus a limited-time 50 credits a day at USD 10 a month
Free: 5,000 code completions a month, unlimited during the promotion; 3 automated tasks, 99 during the promotion

binding_note: the monthly and daily credit counts are the only published allowance, and the credit cost of a request is unpublished, so the number of agent requests they buy is unknown

identity_cost.detail: registration selects a region and signs up with Google or GitHub authorization; Google, GitHub and email login are supported; no card is named for the Free plan

confidence_note: the plan table, the credit counts, the headless flags, the API-key route and the sign-up methods are quoted from first-party pages read. Whether a Free account can mint a CODEBUDDY_API_KEY, the credit cost of a request and the built-in model list of the international edition sit behind a sign-up and are unverified.
